description: E1: the preparation for Orrik's fight. Below the Moot, on the old battery lines, the Skarn keep two fetter-winches in reserve. Break both before the fight and the Moot's two reserve winches never come (world.moot.camp_broken: their crews stay away and the winches are not staked). Optional; 200 XP.

stages.objective: Break the Skarn's two fetter-winches at the winch camp below the Moot
stages.waiting_text: The camp stands on the old battery lines south-west of the Moot, below its rise.
